prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あら、おはよう、セリカ",

    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02893-02894",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "おはよう",
      "en": "Good morning."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02900-02901",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "御主人様、どうぞ此方へ",
      "en": "Master, please come this way."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02903-02906",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリが先に立ち椅子を引いて待つ窓際の席には昨日同様に\n白いテーブルカバーの掛けられ、更に其の窓にだけレースの\nカーテンが付けられ、この食堂には似つかわしくない\n雰囲気を醸し出している",
      "en": "Shuri went ahead and pulled out a chair at the window-side seat. Like yesterday, a white tablecloth covered it, and lace curtains hung only at that window, lending an atmosphere out of place in this dining hall."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02908-02909",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02911-02911",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "まあ、予想し得なかった事ではない",
      "en": "Well, it wasn't unexpected."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02917-02918",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ほらほら、何ぼーっとしているの",
      "en": "Hey, what's with the daydreaming?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02920-02931",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "笑みを浮かべたリンシャに背を押されて其の席に着くと\n直ぐにシュリが朝食を持ってくる\n焼きたてのパンと薄味のスープにサラダ、簡単な、\nそれでいて俺が最も好む朝食のメニューが並べられる\nあまり目立つのは好ましくはないが、この旅にシュリの\n同行を許した時点で予想された事だ\n俺は大人しくシュリの給仕を受けて朝食を済ませると、\n食器を片づけるシュリを見ながら食後の紅茶をゆっくりと\n口に運んだ……",
      "en": "Pushed by the smiling Rinsha, I take my seat. Immediately Shuri brings breakfast. Freshly baked bread, a light soup, and salad — a simple menu, yet my favorite breakfast is laid out. I would prefer not to stand out, but this was expected ever since I allowed Shuri to accompany me on this journey. I quietly accept Shuri's service and finish eating, then, watching Shuri clear the dishes, I slowly sip my after-meal tea..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02940-02943",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "バタンッ\n突然大きな音を立てて入り口の扉が開き、\n男が食堂の中に倒れ込んできた。",
      "en": "Bam! The entrance door burst open, and a man tumbled into the dining hall."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02951-02952",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ランドさん！",
      "en": "Rando!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02954-02954",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "倒れた男・ランドにリンシャが駆け寄る。",
      "en": "Rinsha rushed over to the fallen man, Rando."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02956-02957",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "うう……",
      "en": "Ugh..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02959-02960",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "リシカ！　司祭様を呼んで来て！",

      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リシカ\nは、はいっ\nリンシャに言われて、給仕の娘が外に駆け出していく。",
